The '''XJ-6''' was a luxury [[airspeeder]] [[Hot rod/Canon|hot rod]] manufactured by [[Narglatch AirTech]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic]].

==Descriptions==
The XJ-6 was a flashy,<ref name="DB" /> sleek, open-[[cockpit]] [[airspeeder]] from [[Narglatch AirTech]]. A luxury [[Hot rod/Canon|hot rod]], the [[speeder]] had a driver's seat<ref name="USW" /> and passenger seat, and was available in a yellow [[color]] scheme.<ref name="AOTC" /> The XJ-6 airspeeder was equipped with afterburner [[centrifuge]]s that channeled [[Atmosphere|air]] streams through them.<ref name="CVNE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Oh, you know, Master. I couldn't find a speeder that I really liked, with the open cockpit and the right speed capabilities.|[[Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:XJ-6_hotrod.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Anakin Skywalker borrowed Simon Greyshade's XJ-6 airspeeder while pursuing Zam Wesell.]]
[[Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade]],<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> a wealthy representative of the [[Vorzyd sector]], owned an XJ-6 custom special modified from the [[Narglatch AirTech]] kit,<ref name="USW" /> which featured oversized<ref name="DB" /> twin [[Turbofan|turbojet]] engines located at the vehicle's fore. Originally designed to function in groups of fifty in the wing nacelles of colossal [[seventh-stage bank-courier repulsor-truck]]s on the astronomical object [[Aargau]],<ref name="CVNE" /> the engines utilized a series of thrust ducts to feed pressurized air through the speeder to propel it through atmospheres.<ref name="USW" />

The yellow speeder was docked at a parking bay balcony several floors below [[Padmé's Apartment]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY]], and was commandeered by [[Anakin Skywalker]] to pursue the [[assassin]] [[Zam Wesell]] after she attempted to kill [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. Considering the open-top speeder to be the fastest in the parking bay, Skywalker hotwired Greyshade's vehicle and chased Wesell through the Coruscant [[skylane]]s. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] ultimately landed the speeder outside the [[Outlander Club]] in [[Vos Gesal Street]], and it was later recovered and returned to its designated parkslot. Senator Greyshade was left unable to press charges, and the official inquiry into the vehicle's theft was cut short.<ref name="SWCL" />

[[File:TaggedXJ6Airspeeder-SWH.jpg|250px|thumb|right|A tagged XJ-6 airspeeder at the Grand Arena.]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Hunters Date">{{HuntersDate}}</ref> during the competitive sporting show [[Hunters of the Outer Rim]], a [[Graffiti|tagged]] XJ-6 airspeeder was placed at the [[Grand Arena]]'s [[Coruscant Underworld (battlefield)|Coruscant Underworld]]—a battlefield designed after the [[Coruscant Underworld|underbelly]] of Coruscant—on the planet [[Vespaara]].<ref name="SWH">''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''</ref>
